files.name: new_requirements.pdf
files.text:
Employee Policy v2
Eligibility Requirements
Minimum employee age is 23 years.
Employees must complete onboarding training within 30 days.
Work Arrangement
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week.
All employees must enable multi-factor authentication.
